title: tddworks/baguette
claim: tddworks/baguette — Headless iOS Simulator manager/farm + host-side input injection for iOS 26 — taps, swipes, multi-finger gestures, and 60
why_good: The project addresses a niche in mobile testing by providing a scalable solution for developers needing to simulate complex user interactions on iOS devices.
value: Companies in mobile app development would pay for a subscription model to access the simulator farm, reducing their testing time and costs.
